free.title: Keep every workout in the cloud
free.body: Pro stores each JoyoFit workout with its GPS route and heart rate, restores them on a new phone, and shows them here.
free.localOnly: Without Pro, your workouts stay on your phone.

lapsed: Your Pro is not active, so new workouts are not uploaded until Pro is back. Workouts already stored can still be opened and deleted.

empty.title: No workouts in the cloud yet
empty.body: In the JoyoFit app open Settings, then Cloud sync, and turn sync on. The workouts on your phone start uploading from there.

detail.notFoundBody: This workout was deleted from the cloud or is not in your account.
detail.noAnalysisNote: The full analysis of this workout cannot be shown. The numbers above are still correct.

remove.title: Delete workout from the cloud?
remove.body: This workout is removed from the cloud and from phones that sync it on their next sync. This cannot be undone.

wipe.heading: Workout cloud data
wipe.body: Deletes every workout in the cloud. After that the JoyoFit app stops syncing automatically; turn it back on in Settings, Cloud sync, if you want.
wipe.title: Delete all workout cloud data?
wipe.confirmBody: Every workout in the cloud is deleted permanently. The workouts on your phone stay, and the app stops syncing automatically.
